title: On the Informativeness of Structural Stability Bounds for GNNs: GINs versus GATs
abstract: arXiv:2611.25603v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stability bounds for graph neural networks limit how much node representations can drift when the graph changes, but they are rarely compared with the simplest alternative: a bound on the distance between any two outputs, whatever the graph. We derive structural stability bounds for Graph Isomorphism Networks (GINs) and single-head GATv1 networks under deterministic edge perturbations that need not be small, and compare each with such a perturbation-independent diameter bound. For GINs, we characterize exactly when the stability bound is tighter, through a condition linking perturbation size, depth and maximum degree; it holds with a wide margin on Cora, but fails beyond a few layers on the low-degree MUTAG graphs. For GATv1, the bound is never tighter, which calls for analyses based on attention masses.

translated_title: 论GNN结构稳定性界的信息量：GIN与GAT的对比
translated_abstract: 图神经网络的稳定性界限制了当图发生变化时节点表示可能产生的漂移程度，但人们很少将其与最简单的替代方案进行比较：即不依赖于图结构、对任意两个输出之间距离给出的界。我们在确定性边扰动（不必很小）下，推导了图同构网络（GIN）和单头GATv1网络的结构稳定性界，并将它们分别与这种与扰动无关的直径界进行比较。对于GIN，我们通过一个将扰动大小、网络深度和最大度联系起来的条件，精确刻画了稳定性界何时更紧；该条件在Cora数据集上以很大余量成立，但在低度数的MUTAG图上超过几层后便不再成立。对于GATv1，稳定性界从不更紧，这表明需要开展基于注意力质量的分析。
tldr: 本文推导了GIN和单头GATv1在确定性边扰动下的结构稳定性界，并与扰动无关的直径界对比，精确刻画了GIN稳定性界更紧的条件（在Cora上成立但在低度数的MUTAG上失效），同时发现GATv1的稳定性界从不更紧。
en_tdlr: This paper derives structural stability bounds for GINs and single-head GATv1 under deterministic edge perturbations, exactly characterizing when the GIN bound is tighter than a perturbation-independent diameter bound—holding on Cora but failing on low-degree MUTAG graphs—while showing the GATv1 bound is never tighter.
